digest.component_or_area: plan-review overlay T13; deterministic pre-gate; proposal evaluation (P0/P1/P2/P3)
propositions: T13's trigger lexicon must widen from prohibition-only to obligation-only to detect when plans ADD new contracts/invariants/required arguments that existing sites now owe

A content-triggered surface-parity criterion widening to include NDJSON/import channels would expose a 70% false positive rate (28 of 40 triggers owe nothing) and is dominated by TP cases now covered deterministically by write-parity-contract tests
Deterministic CI checks (import-walk, write-parity oracle with NDJSON adapter) are preferred over new LLM criteria for classes that are measurable without ambiguity

P2 (T13 lexicon edit) is approved as minimal-value prompt-only change; P0/P3/ci-gate-compat are rejected/deferred in favor of deterministic alternatives; P1 assessment recommends rejecting the content-triggered widening
The deterministic pre-gate regex in det_gate_rules.py must gain an additive-obligation alternation branch to make the widened T13 applicability reachable from the router
